lines.beaver: 선생님, 건강 관리는 어디서부터 시작해야 합니까?
lines.beaver_en: Teacher, where should health care begin?
lines.beaver_roman: seonsaengnim, geongang gwallineun eodiseobuteo sijakaeya hamnikka?
lines.en: The first step to a long, healthy life is helping your metabolism.

lines.learner: 몸속 노폐물을 잘 내보내야 면역력도 좋아집니다.
lines.en: Your immunity improves when your body clears out waste.
lines.roman: momsok nopyemureul jal naebonaeya myeonyeongnyeokdo joajimnida.

lines.learner: 양질의 음식을 먹고 어금니로 천천히 씹으세요.
lines.en: Eat good-quality food and chew slowly with your molars.
lines.roman: yangjirui eumsigeul meokgo eogeumniro cheoncheonhi ssibeuseyo.

lines.beaver: 싱겁게 먹으라고들 하는데 맛이 없지 않습니까?
lines.beaver_en: People say to eat bland food, but isn't it tasteless?
lines.beaver_roman: singgeopge meogeuragodeul haneunde masi eopji anseumnikka?
lines.en: It's hard at first, but your sense of taste soon comes back.

lines.learner: 걷기처럼 전신을 쓰는 운동이 심혈관 건강에 좋습니다.
lines.en: Whole-body exercise like walking is good for your cardiovascular health.
lines.roman: geotgicheoreom jeonsineul sseuneun undongi simhyeolgwan geongange josseumnida.

lines.en: Breathing in deeply increases your lung capacity.

lines.beaver_en: Could you also tell us about posture?
lines.learner: 소화가 잘되려면 허리를 곧게 펴고 앉으세요.
lines.en: For good digestion, sit with your back straight.
lines.roman: sohwaga jaldoeryeomyeon heorireul gotge pyeogo anjeuseyo.

lines.beaver_en: How do we keep our brain healthy?
lines.learner: 좌뇌와 우뇌를 함께 쓰면 머리가 맑아집니다.
lines.en: Using both your left and right brain keeps your mind clear.
lines.roman: jwanoewa unoereul hamkke sseumyeon meoriga malgajimnida.

lines.beaver_en: My neck hurts when I sit for a long time.
lines.learner: 뒤통수를 벽에 대고 목을 쭉 펴 보세요.
lines.en: Put the back of your head against a wall and stretch your neck.
lines.roman: dwitongsureul byeoge daego mogeul jjuk pyeo boseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you so much for today's lecture, teacher.
lines.en: Thank you. See you next class.
